title: 有馬記念の後に・冥冥之志

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf might have forfeited the Triple Crown, but she can still win something just as valuable: the shield of the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her spirits are high as she looks to her next race, but they turn to concern when she sees Air Groove, who seems exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that she is the reason Air Groove has been running herself ragged, Symboli Rudolf resolves not to skimp on her presidential duties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the year comes to an end, it seems that the pair's desire to lighten one another's burdens is preventing them from seeing eye to eye.
